nodes.label: Process 0.0: Free Fire Live Kill-Tracking & Leaderboard System
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Central real-time CV and event-ledger system defining the strict operational boundary between live 1080p stream inputs, administrative controls, offline ONNX model delivery, and broadcast/referee outputs.

nodes.label: Observer PC Stream (OBS Virtual Cam / Local RTMP)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: Admin / Referee Console (2nd Monitor / Tablet)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: D1: Roster & ROI Config (Local JSON & In-Memory Dict)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Stores roi_presets.json, 12-team / 48-player lobby manifest, and normalized ASCII skeletons; written pre-match and kept read-only in RAM during live matches for fast deterministic lookup.

nodes.label: D2: Rolling Vote & Cooldown Buffer (Python Deque & TTL Map)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Holds a 1.2s rolling candidate vote buffer and 15s H(killer_id, victim_id) cooldown table supporting high-frequency read/write every 200-250 ms.

nodes.label: D3: SQLite Event Ledger (better-sqlite3 WAL)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Stores matches, teams, players, and kill_events with immutable ACTIVE | VOIDED status transitions via append-only event writes and indexed ACTIVE aggregations in WAL mode.

nodes.label: D4: Crop Evidence Store (/crops/)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Persists PNG thumbnails of kill-feed strips flagged with confidence below 85%, written by the Python CV worker and served over HTTP to the Referee UI.

nodes.label: D5: Local ONNX Model Store (/models/)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Stores ff_icons_v11n.onnx icon detector and RapidOCR ONNX weights, loaded once into ONNX Runtime memory at worker startup.

nodes.label: 1.1 Manifest Validator (Ingest 12 Teams & 48 Player IGNs)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 1.2 Skeleton Builder (Strip Unicode & Index ASCII Keys)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Converts stylized Unicode player IGNs into normalized ASCII lookup keys prior to match drop so fuzzy matching handles stylized Free Fire usernames cleanly.

nodes.label: 1.3 ROI Calibrator (Align Killfeed, Alive & Guard Boxes)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Verifies and calibrates resolution-independent normalized HUD crop ratios (roi_presets.json) on a clean 1080p spectator lobby frame.

nodes.label: 1.4 Session Init (Create Match Row & Zero Team Totals)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 2.1 Sampler (4-5 FPS Grab, 200-250ms)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 2.2 ROI Slicer (Killfeed, Alive & Guard Crops)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 2.3 State Guard (Active Match vs Replay Check)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Pauses vision processing automatically via Pause (Replay) drop sink during replays or lobby transitions to avoid false kill counts.

nodes.label: 2.4 SSIM Gate (Pixel Diff Static Frame Filter)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Discards static frames via pixel differencing before YOLO or OCR ever runs, saving 70-85% CPU.

nodes.label: 2.5 Row Segmenter (Slice 3-5 Active Banner Strips)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 2.6 Icon Detector (ONNX Kill vs Knock + Icon BBox)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Runs YOLOv11-nano to drop knockdown banners early and uses the detected weapon/skull bounding box (x_min/max) to split Killer and Victim text regions cleanly.

nodes.label: 2.7 Name Cropper (Left = Killer Crop, Right = Victim Crop)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 3.1 Condition (2x-3x Upscale, CLAHE & Thresh)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Enhances kill-feed text legibility against bright explosions or sky textures before RapidOCR extraction.

nodes.label: 3.2 RapidOCR (Extract Raw K & V Strings)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 3.3 Normalize (Strip Noise & Playzone Check)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 3.4 RapidFuzz (Closed-Set 48-Player Match)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Matches normalized OCR strings against the closed set of 48 known player skeletons from D1 to eliminate out-of-lobby OCR hallucinations.

nodes.label: 3.5 3-Tier Router (Team Rules & Confidence Gate)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Rejects self-team noise via Drop Self-Kill (same team ID) and routes matches by confidence into Auto-Pass (>=85%), Temporal Hold (65-84%), or Referee Review (<65%).

nodes.label: 4.1 Consensus Voter (1.2s Rolling Window, >=2 of 3 Frames)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Prevents single-frame OCR glitches by requiring >=2-of-3 frame agreement within a 1.2s rolling window before advancing a candidate pair.

nodes.label: 4.2 Revival Dedup (Hash H(killer, victim), 15s Cooldown)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Eliminates banner double-counting with a 15-second sliding hash cooldown that remains compatible with Free Fire revivals.

nodes.label: 4.3 Drift Monitor (HUD Alive OCR vs Internal Living Count)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Independently cross-checks the global HUD Alive counter against internal living count to trigger an Amber Drift Alert (>5s) if eliminations are missed or overcounted.

nodes.label: 5.1 Writer (Immutable Event Append)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 5.2 Aggregator (Sum Team Kills & Alive Count)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Executes a clean full-match recomputation over ACTIVE SQLite rows on every kill or override to guarantee zero counter drift.

nodes.label: 5.3 Sorter (Deterministic Tie-Breaking)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 5.4 Socket.IO (Real-Time Diff Fan-Out)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: Deterministic Tie-Breaker Priority Order (Total Kills DESC -> Alive Players DESC -> First-Reach TS ASC)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Defines strict deterministic ranking priority: 1. Total Kills (DESC), 2. Alive Players (DESC), 3. First-Reach Timestamp (ASC).

nodes.label: 6.1 Queue Aggregator (Bundle Crops, Ticker & Alive Drift Warnings)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 6.2 Override Validator (Confirm / Reassign / Manual Add / Undo)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf

nodes.label: 6.3 Audit & Re-Sync (Mark Old Row VOIDED + Insert Corrected ACTIVE)
nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Leverages the 10-30s stream broadcast delay for non-destructive human-in-the-loop correction, preserving full audit history by voiding superseded rows and inserting corrected ACTIVE events prior to re-ranking.

nodes.source_file: Free Fire Live Kill Tracker DFDs.pdf
